records.current_holder: The National Archives, State Papers, inv.nr. 106 box 7.
records.additional_information: A nomenclature, mixed with a simple substitution cipher with nulls, comprising of slightly less than 1100 codegroups. The lay-out of this key is remarkable. I consists of three sheets with 12 columns of 30 entries each, numbered consecutively from 1 to 9 and 49 to 69 and headed by two 2-digit numbers dived by a dot. The numbers in the headings cannot be found in the columns. It seems likely that each codegroup was formed by the number in the column combined by one of the numbers in the heading, picked at will.
